notes.title: Award at the 2nd GYAAR Indie Game Contest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41852435/2ea167ce526c720210cf533f0b79df2059f76f24.png[/img]

We are excited to announce that our game: "Projéct Timi: Sasha's Curse" won the Honorable Mention award at the [b]2nd GYAAR Studio Indie Game Contest[/b] by [b]Bandai Namco[/b]! 

[url=https://indie.bandainamcostudios.com/gyaarcon-2/results]2nd GYAAR Studio Ingie Game Contest Results[/url]

[b]Projéct Timi: Sasha's Curse[/b] is a 3D cozy musical-action game mashup. Use the rhythm of the music to activate magic traps, fend off nightmares, and protect the dreams of the people in Lucity Town from Sasha’s evil curse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41852435/f7a528b7e15974d2a802a0b42ad2ecdca229c7a7.png[/img]

Quote by the judges:
[i]"We were speechless at how well this was created and how much attention to detail was involved in designing the unique world with adorable characters, beautiful animation, and storyline. It felt great when you nailed the tempo during the sequences where you match the rhythm to proceed through the level."[/i]

Thanks to everyone at Ephemeral Cube, our supporters, #GYAARCon, Supercell, and BANDAI NAMCO Studios Inc.❤︎ !

notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Greetings, Dreamers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41852435/cf1c7392ad899404bfe5a73170eb48a44ff561f2.gif[/img]

We are excited to share that the demo for [b]Projéct Timi: Sasha's Curse[/b] is now live! Embark on this exclusive adventure from[b] October 13th, 2023[/b], to [b]October 20th, 2023[/b].

Timi & Mr.Moon will be using this opportunity to take feedback from the community! We wanna hear your thoughts. What you like, what you don't like, bugs, and ideas. After your playthrough, make sure to connect with us on social media, let us know what you think and help us improve.

🎮 [b]What Awaits You in the Demo?[/b]

[list]
[*] 🎨 A Striking Visual Transformation!
[*] 🎥 Fresh, Dynamic Animated Sequences!
[*] 📜 A Sneak Peek into the Enigmatic Story of Projéct Timi: Sasha's Curse
[*] 🗝️ 2 Levels, Featuring 3 Hidden Book Collectibles, Optional Missions, and Additional Surprises!
[*] 🐦 Engage in a Riveting Boss Battle with Pepe Pigeon!
[/list]

Embark on this early journey, uncover secrets, face challenges, and immerse yourself in the unfolding tale of Projéct Timi: Sasha's Curse.

Make sure to tag us on [url=https://twitter.com/projecttimi]Twitter [/url]or [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@projecttimi]TikTok [/url]if you share our demo! Once again, thanks for all the love and support. 

HAVE FUN 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41852435/3a1dd50081bb796bdd849319cb957b310ae0ff29.gif[/img]
